blurb.text: A wine area that is both an IG and a DOC in Mendoza, with Agrelo, Alto Agrelo, Las Compuertas and Vistalba inside. Malbec dominates plantings at 58%, followed by Cabernet Sauvignon (13%) and Bonarda (4%).
